name: North Carolina Department of Transportation
mission: Connecting people, products, and places safely and efficiently with customer-focused mobility solutions that spur economic growth.

goals.title: Safety & Vision Zero: Eliminate Roadway Fatalities and Severe Injuries
goals.description: Deploy proven safety countermeasures across high-risk rural two-lane highways, modernize intersection signalization, and protect vulnerable road users.
objectives: Eliminate fatal crashes on rural secondary routes through rumble strips and high-friction surfacing
Implement safe bicycle and pedestrian crossings along urban arterial corridors
Modernize highway work zone intrusion prevention technologies

goals.title: Resilient Transportation Infrastructure & Extreme Weather Adaptation
goals.description: Harden evacuation routes, seismic and scour-retrofit critical bridges, and upgrade coastal highway culverts to withstand severe hurricanes and riverine flooding.
objectives: Elevate and reinforce coastal evacuation corridors (e.g., NC 12, US 70)
Replace structurally deficient or scour-critical bridges across mountain and piedmont basins
Implement nature-based roadside stormwater drainage solutions

goals.title: Clean Transportation, Fleet Electrification, and Alternative Fuels
goals.description: Build out North Carolina's NEVI corridor EV charging backbone, transition public transit fleets to low/zero emissions, and invest in multimodal freight efficiency.
objectives: Deploy DC fast charging stations every 50 miles along designated alternative fuel corridors
Support municipal and rural transit agency purchases of electric and hydrogen buses
Establish commercial vehicle clean charging hubs near major logistic corridors

goals.title: Multimodal Freight, Intermodal Rail, and Maritime Logistics Corridors
goals.description: Improve freight movement across rail, highway, and port facilities at Wilmington and Morehead City to relieve highway freight congestion.
objectives: Expand Class I and short-line rail intermodal capacity along the Southeast Corridor
Upgrade port rail connector tracks and heavy container barge berths
Eliminate at-grade rail crossings to reduce freight bottlenecks and emissions

goals.title: Rural Transit Equity and Micro-Mobility Connectivity
goals.description: Expand on-demand microtransit and dial-a-ride options in underserved rural counties, connect workers to employment hubs, and enhance accessibility for seniors and disabled citizens.
objectives: Fund app-based on-demand microtransit pilots across Tier 1 economically distressed counties
Provide direct non-emergency medical transportation in rural healthcare deserts
Integrate regional transit payment cards and coordinated schedules
